Model Pricing
K3 Series Models
All K3 series models support a 1,048,576-token context window.
Model	Base tokens	Prompt caching
Name	Input	Output	Cached Input	5m writes	1h writes
kimi-k3.1-pro	$2.00 / MTok	$10.00 / MTok	$0.20 / MTok	$2.00 / MTok	$4.00 / MTok
kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed	$4.00 / MTok	$20.00 / MTok	$0.20 / MTok	$4.00 / MTok	$8.00 / MTok
kimi-k3	$3.00 / MTok	$15.00 / MTok	$0.30 / MTok	$3.00 / MTok	$6.00 / MTok
Note: The Kimi API automatically enables context caching billing for repeated request prefixes, with a default TTL (time-to-live) of 5m. For TTL settings and cost optimization tips, see Best Practices for Context Caching.
Batch API Inference: kimi-k3.1-pro and kimi-k3 support batch inference for large-scale tasks that do not require real-time responses, billed at 60% of the standard price.
K2 Series Models
All K2 series models support a 262,144-token context window.
Dear Kimi Users, starting October 31, 2026, K2 series models will no longer be available to newly registered users; existing users are not affected. We plan to retire all K2 series models by the end of December 2026, please prepare your migration in advance.
